merge_method: TWO scenarios, do not confuse them. (A) INCREMENTAL SYNC — the normal case, used for v5..v8: per-file delta 3-way. base = the PREVIOUS synced_to_commit, theirs = new hermes HEAD, ours = current kopi tip. For each file in `git diff --name-status -M base theirs`, transform path+content (case-preserving hermes->kopi + hermes-agent/kopi-agent->kopi-ai-agent), then `git merge-file` into kopi's worktree. Tooling: scratchpad `batch_merge.py <hermes> <kopi> <base> <theirs>`; split large ranges into contiguous batches and merge/compile/test each. Because the delta contains ONLY real upstream changes, there is NO silent-drop risk. (B) FROM-SCRATCH RE-FORK — rare, only if you ever re-materialize the whole tree: base MUST be c1b46d9 (kopi's TRUE initial rebranded commit, the real common ancestor), NOT a synthetic T(fork) — a too-new base silently drops upstream code as 'ours deleted it'. c1b46d9 applies ONLY to scenario B; never use it as the base for an incremental delta. BATCH BOUNDARIES MUST COME FROM --first-parent (learned v15): pick them with `git rev-list --reverse --first-parent <base>..origin/main`, NOT `--no-merges`. With --no-merges the list is topologically ordered across merged PR branches, so the commit at index N/10 can be a side-branch tip whose TREE predates changes already merged earlier in the range; `git diff base <that commit>` then reports hundreds of phantom deletions (v15 batch1 showed DEL=383 for files that exist at both ends). First-parent commits are real mainline states, so every batch diff is a genuine forward step. Sanity check before merging a batch: `git diff --name-status <prev> <boundary> | awk '{print substr($1,1,1)}' | sort | uniq -c` -- a D count far above the whole range's real deletions means the boundary is bad.

green_ci_runbook: Run these AFTER every merge, BEFORE pushing, so CI passes on the first try (each item is a real failure we hit and fixed; skipping one turns main red). Order matters. 1) LOCKFILES: `uv lock` (pyproject version/deps changed -> uv lock --check is a blocking CI gate and every test slice dies on uv sync --locked) AND `npm install` at repo root (any package.json dep change -> npm ci fails EUSAGE 'Missing X from lock file'; the @playwright/test devDep bit us). 2) VERSION SOURCES: run `scripts/bump-version.sh` (no args) to VERIFY all 4 sources agree (package.json, apps/desktop/package.json, pyproject.toml, kopi_cli/__init__.py); the script also re-locks uv.lock. NOTE: acp_registry/agent.json + tests/acp/test_registry_manifest.py were REMOVED in v9 following upstream #68217 (ACP registry ripped out with brew/PyPI); bump-version.sh's write_agent_json is a no-op guard now (skips if absent). 3) BRAND/ORG: `grep -rn 'NousResearch/hermes-agent\|hermes-agent.git' --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.ts' --include='*.ps1'` must be empty (source install/update paths must point at kopiagent/kopi-ai-agent, not upstream). ALSO check package.json brand (the grep above skips it): package.json + apps/desktop/package.json must keep homepage=https://kopiaiagent.com, appId com.kopiaiagent.kopi, maintainer/author 'Kopi Ai Agent Pte Ltd', repository/bugs URLs on kopiagent/kopi-ai-agent -- v9 took upstream apps/desktop/package.json and reverted these, and the missing homepage broke the Linux deb/rpm release build (electron-builder fpm: 'Please specify project homepage') so mac+win shipped but Linux did not. Verify: grep -n '"homepage"\|"appId"\|"maintainer"\|"author"' package.json apps/desktop/package.json . 4) STALE INSTALL TESTS: the 13 tests/test_install_sh_*.py + test_install_{diverged_update,lockfile_churn,no_initial_commit,unmerged_index,autostash_conflict_recovery} modules assert the OLD upstream linear installer and MUST stay `pytestmark = skip` (KOPI uses the staged Hermes installer; coverage is tests/test_install_sh_kopi.py). A sync that un-skips them turns CI red. 5) LINT: `npm run fix` at root (eslint --fix + prettier); the js-autofix workflow pushes fixes straight to main now (no AUTOFIX_BOT_PAT), but landing them yourself keeps CI green immediately. 6) JS/TS TYPECHECK+LINT PER WORKSPACE (do NOT skip -- this is what bit v12): a Python-only local test pass MISSES TypeScript breaks that the 'JS & TS checks' CI jobs catch. Union merges of electron/main.ts + web/App.tsx are the usual culprits (upstream adds code referencing a symbol our variant doesn't import/destructure). BEFORE pushing run at minimum `cd apps/desktop && npm run check:lint` (that's `tsc --noEmit` across ., tsconfig.electron.json, tsconfig.e2e.json THEN eslint) -- and the sibling `check` targets for web/ ui-tui/ if those trees changed. v12 example: the ElectronNS union kept our `const {app,BrowserWindow,...}=electron` destructure but took upstream's Quick Entry using bare `globalShortcut` -> TS2304, red 'apps/desktop / check:lint'. Fix was adding globalShortcut to the destructure (commit 30cea12). RULE: do not push to main until BOTH the Python full run AND the JS/TS typecheck+lint for every changed workspace are green locally.
